adjudication.rationale: In the new `embeddable-host` component, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { ... })` with no `.catch(...)` (unlike `save()`, which ends with `.catch(popupAjaxError)`). If the DELETE fails, the promise rejection is unhandled and no error is shown; the host is also not removed from the UI because `deleteHost` is only sent on success.
